meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 相当于一个小说封面设计师：你给书名、作者笔名和目标平台，它会判断题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成带书名和署名的封面图，首次给 2-3 个构图方案，并可导出平台上传尺寸版本。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-cover、/封面 等指令，或说「生成封面图」时触发；书名或笔名缺失时，它会先问你补全，不会自己编。

say.text: 帮我做个封面，书名《剑起长安》，笔名青衫客，目标平台番茄小说
say.note: 缺信息会先问你，然后出 2-3 个构图方案

say.text: 用这张参考图做封面，书名《迷雾之城》，作者林砚
say.note: 有参考图时改走图生图通路

say.text: 把刚生成的封面导出成番茄 600×800 上传版

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude acts as a novel cover designer: given title, author name and target platform, it judges the genre, calls GPT-Image-2 to make a cover containing title and byline, offers 2-3 layout options first, and can export a platform upload-size version.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-cover, /cover or requests like "generate a cover image"; if the title or pen name is missing it asks you first instead of making them up.

say_en.text: Make a cover: title "Sword Over Chang'an", pen name Qingshanke, platform Fanqie.
say_en.note: It asks for anything missing, then offers 2-3 options

say_en.text: Use this reference image for the cover: title "City of Mist", author Lin Yan.
Export the cover I just made as the Fanqie 600x800 upload version.
say_en.note: Center-crops and resizes to the platform size
